# grafana-adaptive-logs_drop_rule (Resource)

Manages an Adaptive Logs drop rule: a deterministic rule that drops a percentage of log lines matching a stream selector. Scope it to a segment via `segment_id` to express a "segment override", or use `__global__` for a tenant-wide rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "grafana-adaptive-logs_segment" "sre" {
  name     = "SRE team"
  selector = "{team=\"sre\"}"
}

# A tenant-wide drop rule.
resource "grafana-adaptive-logs_drop_rule" "healthchecks" {
  segment_id = "__global__"
  name       = "drop noisy health checks"

  body = {
    stream_selector   = "{service_name=\"api-gateway\"}"
    drop_rate         = 90
    levels            = ["info", "debug"]
    log_line_contains = ["healthcheck"]
  }
}

# A "segment override": the same kind of rule, scoped to one segment instead
# of __global__.
resource "grafana-adaptive-logs_drop_rule" "sre_override" {
  segment_id = grafana-adaptive-logs_segment.sre.id
  name       = "SRE team override"

  body = {
    stream_selector = "{service_name=\"api-gateway\"}"
    drop_rate       = 35
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `body` (Attributes) The rule definition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--body))
- `name` (String) A human-readable name for the drop rule.
- `segment_id` (String) The segment this rule belongs to. Use `__global__` for a tenant-wide rule, or a `grafana-adaptive-logs_segment` resource's `id` to scope it to that segment.

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the drop rule is currently disabled.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp after which this drop rule no longer applies.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the drop rule was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the drop rule, set by the server.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the drop rule was last updated.
- `version` (Number) Optimistic concurrency version, set by the server and incremented on every update.

<a id="nestedatt--body"></a>
### Nested Schema for `body`

Required:

- `drop_rate` (Number) Percentage (0-100) of matching lines to drop.
- `stream_selector` (String) A LogQL stream selector defining which log streams this rule applies to.

Optional:

- `levels` (List of String) Log levels to match, e.g. ["info", "debug"]. Matches all levels if unset.
- `log_line_contains` (List of String) Strings that must appear in the log line for this rule to apply.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import grafana-adaptive-logs_drop_rule.healthchecks <drop-rule-id>
```
